name: When is the right time to invest in accessibility modifications?

mainEntity.name: When is the right time to invest in accessibility modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider remodeling when an existing space presents a slip, fall, or movement hazard, or before a planned transition such as returning home after surgery. Early warning signs include difficulty stepping over high tub walls, trouble maneuvering walkers through narrow 28-inch doorways, or lack of support near toilets and showers. Planning these updates proactively prevents rushed emergency decisions and allows time to select durable tile, proper fixtures, and comfortable layouts without stress.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider modifying your home when daily tasks like stepping into a tub or entering narrow rooms feel unsafe, or well before a family member with limited mobility moves in.
